summary: Site walk-through of the Lot 1 set-out and discussion of OPW commencement. Centro confirmed plant booking for civil works week commencing 25 May. Asbestos scrape sequencing locked in. No outstanding RFIs; structural docs reviewed on site against the IFC package.

topics.heading: 01 Set-out & Survey
bullets: Lot 1 corner pegs verified against the surveyor's drawings — no encroachment issues.
Centro to set up site office adjacent to existing driveway from 25 May.

topics.heading: 02 Civil Works — Commencement
bullets: Plant booking confirmed for 25 May start (excavator + dump truck).
QLeave receipt received; OPW approval pending Council acknowledgement.
Asbestos scrape to commence immediately after Council go-ahead.

topics.heading: 03 Structural — IFC Package Review
bullets: Burchills IFC reviewed on site; no clashes flagged with surveyor set-out.
Reinforcement tonnages match Centro's tender allowance — no variation risk identified at this stage.

actions.action: Confirm Council acknowledgement of QLeave receipt and circulate OPW approval letter.
Submit detailed pre-start checklist and SWMS for asbestos handling.
Issue formal NTC once OPW released.
Schedule SM005 for week commencing 1 June.
